listen.address.description: IP address the server binds to (e.g., '127.0.0.1', '::', or '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

listen.port.description: TCP port to listen on (default 79 — standard finger port).

user.description: Unix user account to drop privileges to after startup.

group.description: Unix group to drop privileges to after startup.

root.description: Chroot directory (e.g., '/var/efingerd'). Empty string disables chroot for security.

verbose.description: Enable detailed logging (including client requests and errors).

logfile.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log to stderr.

db_path.description: Path to the fingerprint (user) database file.

timeout.description: Connection timeout in seconds before the server drops the client.

allow_anonymous.description: If enabled, allows finger queries without authentication.

allowed_ips.description: List of IP addresses explicitly allowed to connect. If non-empty, only these IPs may connect (whitelist).

denied_ips.description: List of IP addresses explicitly denied access (blacklist). Takes precedence over allowed_ips only when both are set (deny wins).

items.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address or CIDR range (e.g., '10.0.0.0/8').

response_templates.description: Map of regex patterns to custom finger response templates. Use '{{ user }}' to insert queried username.

items.description: Jinja2-like template string for dynamic response.

default_response.description: Fallback response when no response template matches the username.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for connections (requires valid certificate/key).

ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL certificate file (PEM format). Required if SSL is enabled.

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key file (PEM format). Required if SSL is enabled.

ipv6_enabled.description: Enable IPv6 support (dual-stack if IPv4 is also available).
